verdict.rationale: Mercury documents AI bill capture that reads bills, auto-populates details and remembers past recipients so users can approve and pay. Payments can be routed through organization approval policies or queued for dashboard sign-off, and transactions can be categorized and synced to QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite. Nothing in the evidence covers matching invoices to purchase orders, and coding is shown only as transaction categorization rather than invoice-level GL coding. missing for 10: purchase-order matching, invoice-level GL coding, automatic approval-routing rules tied to bills, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI bill workflow.
